thag3.9:1.4: adīnamānaso → adīnamanaso (cck, pts) | alīnamanaso → adīnamanaso (sya-all: yu.)
thag3.9:3.4: tatuttarinti → tatuttarinti itthaṁ sudaṁ āyasmā (bj) | tatuttarinti yasojo thero → tat uttarin ti (pts)
